# Pack v4 — Ron's screen story: "context freezes → a hand presses one key → warm session"

**The concept (Ron's):** while typing, the screen fills with ice · we see the developer
typing in the room · a warning appears: *"Context too large — consider starting a new
session"* · a hand reaches from behind the developer's shoulder, presses ONE key, and
says: **"אל תדאג — יש לנו inferno"** · the ice melts and a fresh warm session appears.

**The golden rule of the split:** anything ON the screen is NEVER generated by Veo
(text-to-video can't do legible UI). Screen beats are real motion graphics.
**Status: the two screen videos are ALREADY MADE** (rendered by Claude, in
`assets/inserts/`): 

- `INSERT_A_context_freeze.mp4` — 8s, 720×1280: typing in a chat, context meter climbs
  82%→99% and turns red, frost creeps over the UI, warning toast slides in.
- `INSERT_B_warm_start.mp4` — 8s, 720×1280: key-flash, frost melts, warm glow rises,
  "🔥 infernoflow — warm start" + restored memories (real dogfood content: prisma
  gotcha, bookmark) + "Welcome back" bubble.

## Shot list (only ONE new Veo generation needed)

| # | Shot | Source | Length used |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Developer typing in the warm room (behind view) | **Veo — already approved** (segment 1) | ~4s |
| 2 | Screen: typing → freeze → warning | **INSERT_A (done)** | ~6-8s |
| 3 | A hand reaches over his shoulder, presses ONE key | **Veo — the one new prompt below** | ~4s |
| 4 | Screen: melt → warm start session | **INSERT_B (done)** | ~6-8s |

Total ≈ 24–28s. VO "אל תדאג — יש לנו inferno." (ElevenLabs, warm old voice) lands on
shot 3, right as the key is pressed.

## 🎬 The one new Veo prompt — Shot 3: the hand over the shoulder

```
Vertical 9:16 composition. A warm rustic home office at night: a young man with short
dark hair sits at a wooden desk with his back to camera, facing a glowing monitor,
warm amber firelight flickering from off-screen right, deep cozy shadows, near-black
corners #0d0f16.

Action: an old man's weathered hand, in a warm beige knit cardigan sleeve, gently
enters the frame from behind the young man's right shoulder, reaches down to the
keyboard, and presses a SINGLE key with one finger — one calm, decisive keystroke —
then rests reassuringly on the young man's shoulder. The young man's head turns
slightly, surprised then relieved. The monitor glow warms from cool white to amber
as the key lands.

Camera: static over-the-shoulder medium close-up framing the shoulder, the keyboard
and the reaching hand. No cuts.
Lighting: monitor glow + warm firelight; the glow warms noticeably after the keypress.
Audio: one clean satisfying key press, soft fire crackle. No speech (VO added in edit).
Duration: 8 seconds.

Negative prompt: no readable text on screen, no code, no user interface visible in
detail, no woman, no full second person in frame (only the hand and sleeve), no
captions, no camera cuts, no black bars.
```

## ✂️ Assembly notes
- Cut 1→2 on the developer's hands touching the keys (motion match into the screen).
- INSERT_A's toast lands ~5s in — hold 1-2 beats, then cut to shot 3.
- Time the VO "אל תדאג — יש לנו inferno" so "inferno" hits exactly on the keystroke,
  then cut to INSERT_B's key-flash — it reads as the same press.
- INSERT_B's "Welcome back" bubble is the emotional landing — hold it.
- The screen inserts are native 720×1280 (full vertical frame) — no corner-pin
  compositing needed; they cut in as full-screen "what he sees" shots.
- English cut caption alt: "Don't worry — we've got inferno."

INSERT_B shows real product behavior (memory restore + bookmark resume, real dogfood
gotcha). The "warm start" framing matches what infernoflow actually does — inject
